items.title: [Duplicate of #18] [P0] 고정 6-max 100BB 학습 모드와 세션 종료 계약을 추가한다
items.body:
## 배경

현재 게임 설정은 `aiCount`, `startStack`, `blinds0`, `levelEvery`만 가지며, 핸드 번호에 따라 블라인드 레벨이 자동으로 상승하고 사용자가 버스트하거나 모든 AI가 탈락하면 게임이 종료됩니다. 이 구조는 토너먼트 플레이에는 적합하지만, 동일 스택·동일 포지션 조건을 반복 비교해야 하는 GTO 학습에는 변수가 너무 많습니다.

정밀 분석 문서: [docs/GTO_LEARNING_ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/Sungmin-Cho/AI-Holdem/blob/docs/gto-learning-roadmap/docs/GTO_LEARNING_ROADMAP.md)

## 현재 코드에서 확인된 제약

- `engine/hand.js`
  - `createGame()`의 config에 게임 모드 개념이 없습니다.
  - `startHand()`가 `handNo / levelEvery`로 레벨을 계산합니다.
  - 칩이 0인 좌석을 영구 탈락 처리하고, 사용자 버스트/AI 전멸을 `gameOver`로 사용합니다.
- `engine/cli.js`
  - `init` 옵션은 `--ai`, `--stack`, `--blinds`, `--level-every`뿐입니다.
- `engine/game-archive.js`
  - 새 게임 생성 시 항상 토너먼트형 `createGame()` 계약을 사용합니다.
- `tools/game-loop.js`
  - 종료 진입 조건이 `gameOver` 또는 사용자 bust에 강하게 결합되어 있습니다.
- `engine/views.js`, `server/public/app.js`
  - UI 상단은 레벨과 다음 레벨까지 남은 핸드를 항상 표시합니다.

## 목표

기존 토너먼트 모드를 보존하면서, 비교 가능한 학습 데이터를 생성하는 별도 `training` 모드를 추가합니다.

초기 학습 모드 계약:

- 6-max 고정: 사용자 1 + AI 5
- 블라인드 고정: 기본 50/100
- 시작 유효 스택: 100BB
- 매 핸드 시작 시 모든 좌석을 100BB로 재설정
- 좌석 탈락 없음
- 기본 100핸드 후 세션 종료
- 버튼은 기존 방식대로 순환
- 세션 종료는 `result: "completed"`로 표현하고 기존 `win|lose|abort`와 구분
- 기존 토너먼트 모드는 동작과 저장 형식을 변경하지 않음

## 제안 설계

```json
{
  "config": {
    "mode": "tournament | training",
    "aiCount": 5,
    "startStack": 10000,
    "blinds0": [50, 100],
    "levelEvery": null,
    "sessionHands": 100,
    "stackPolicy": "carry | reset-each-hand"
  }
}
```

CLI 예시:

```bash
node engine/cli.js init --mode training --hands 100
node tools/game-loop.js --game-dir game --ai 5 --mode training --hands 100
```

## 변경 대상 파일

- `engine/hand.js`
- `engine/cli.js`
- `engine/game-archive.js`
- `engine/views.js`
- `tools/game-loop.js`
- `server/public/app.js`
- `server/public/index.html`
- `.agents/skills/start-game/SKILL.md`
- `README.md`
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `test/hand-setup.test.js`
- `test/cli.test.js`
- `test/game-loop.test.js`
- `test/tempo-skill-contract.test.js`

## 완료 조건

- [ ] `tournament`가 명시적 기본값이며 기존 테스트와 저장 파일이 회귀하지 않는다.
- [ ] `training`은 정확히 6좌석, 고정 블라인드, 매 핸드 100BB로 시작한다.
- [ ] training 핸드 종료 후 좌석이 탈락하지 않고 다음 핸드에 복구된다.
- [ ] `sessionHands`에 도달하면 `gameOver:true`, `result:"completed"`가 된다.
- [ ] 중단/재개 후에도 남은 핸드 수와 stack reset 계약이 보존된다.
- [ ] UI에서 training일 때 레벨 관련 표시는 숨기고 `진행 핸드/목표 핸드`를 표시한다.
- [ ] 종합 리뷰와 코치 finalization이 `completed` 결과에서도 정상 동작한다.
- [ ] `node --test`와 `npm run test:ci`가 통과한다.

## 범위 밖

- 토너먼트 ICM
- ante 및 다양한 rake 구조
- heads-up 전용 학습 모드
- 실제 현금 가치 또는 결제 기능

## 의존 관계

이 이슈가 완료되어야 canonical spot이 고정되므로, 프리플랍 GTO 평가와 반복 드릴 구현의 선행 조건입니다.

## Gate

`HG-0020` — independent review, mobile signing, pilot telemetry, staged rollout, kill switch, rollback, and public-release evidence.

## Qualified source baseline

- PR: #1
- exact head: `018edaf55630f45765040ae055ba5f0534e52bc0`
- exact tree: `41ae3ff315824d77f8dc83b17634cc0f5d8a0b19`
- exact-head CI: `33279411065`
- source-evidence artifact: `hepta-source-evidence-018edaf55630f45765040ae055ba5f0534e52bc0`
- artifact SHA-256: `4a8780a61fe71192dfbd59171959b40b2e768ecd6b351a21abf11d2a166872ad`
- SBOM digest: `88ded0ba952e24ef87b3361d22055ff535e850e2e628ed2d9ae1715e8d9cc837`
- provenance digest: `a27fd2a5421f29dd52afb11b3368580e71157462b26ad82974f831d5bd2cc1c7`

The source package provides `services/qualification/release_gate.py`, source SBOM/provenance generation, product evidence schema, review checklist, release/rollback runbook, and a non-overridable product gate.

## Required external inputs

- independent security reviewer and report;
- independent privacy/legal review and retention matrix;
- accessibility and wearer-safety review;
- Android and iOS signing identities, store accounts, release keys and custody records;
- staged rollout infrastructure, on-call ownership and telemetry;
- minimum pilot cohort and real crash/duplicate-effect metrics;
- kill-switch and rollback operators.

## Exit criteria

1. Security, privacy, legal, accessibility and safety findings are closed or explicitly accepted by named owners.
2. Signed Android/iOS artifacts are content-addressed and linked to exact source provenance.
3. Kill-switch exercise disables model, capability, Skill and/or release paths as designed.
4. Rollback restores the previous compatible version and preserves task/device correctness.
5. Pilot cohort is at least five users, crash-free rate is at least 99%, and duplicate side effects are zero.
6. `tools/evaluate_release_gate.py --mode product` passes with no override and its bundle enters `docs/EVIDENCE_INDEX.yaml`.

Source CI and synthetic pilot values cannot close this issue.

items.body:
### Description

After updating Elementor from 4.2.3 to 4.3.1 and Elementor Pro from 4.2.2 to 4.3.0, a staging site protected by standard server-level HTTP Basic Authentication started displaying repeated authentication prompts in Google Chrome.

The initial request is successfully authenticated and the page loads. Elementor then sends same-origin requests to:

`/wp-json/elementor/v1/events/api/flags/`

These requests explicitly set an `Authorization: Basic ...` header containing an Elementor events token. This replaces the browser's valid site-level HTTP Basic Auth credentials.

The web server consequently interprets the Elementor token as the Basic Auth username, rejects it, and returns `401 Unauthorized` with a new authentication challenge. Chrome then displays the username/password dialog repeatedly.

The server log confirms the conflict:
user "<redacted Elementor events token>" was not found in the HTTP Basic Auth password file

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a clean WordPress staging installation.
2. Use the Hello Elementor theme.
3. Install and activate only Elementor 4.3.1 and Elementor Pro 4.3.0.
4. Protect the entire site with standard server-level HTTP Basic Authentication.
5. Clear the browser and server caches.
6. Open the site or WordPress administration area in Google Chrome.
7. Enter the correct HTTP Basic Auth credentials.
8. Open an Elementor page or an admin page that loads Elementor's events functionality.
9. Inspect the request to `/wp-json/elementor/v1/events/api/flags/`.
10. Observe that Elementor sends its own `Authorization: Basic ...` header.
11. Observe the `401 Unauthorized` response and the repeated browser authentication prompt.

### Expected behavior

Elementor should not replace an existing same-origin `Authorization` header used for server-level HTTP Basic Authentication.
The events request should use an authentication mechanism that does not conflict with standard HTTP authentication, such as a custom header, a WordPress nonce, a request parameter, or a server-side request.

A staging site protected with HTTP Basic Authentication should remain usable without repeated browser login prompts.

items.title: [Duplicate of #21] [UI] 추천 액션·빈도·EV loss·range를 단계적으로 보여주는 학습 피드백을 추가한다
items.body:
## 배경

현재 `server/public/`은 게임 테이블, action 입력, 코치 노트와 종료 리뷰를 제공하지만, 의사결정 평가를 구조적으로 보여 주는 UI는 없습니다. 새 StrategyEvaluation을 사용자가 빠르게 이해하면서도 필요할 때 깊게 볼 수 있도록 progressive disclosure가 필요합니다.

설계 문서: `docs/design/gto-learning-system-roadmap.md` (`docs/gto-learning-roadmap-20260831` 브랜치)

## 목표

- 선택 직후 또는 핸드 종료 후 평가 카드를 표시한다.
- 내 선택, 추천 선택, grade, EV loss/미지원 상태를 한눈에 보여 준다.
- 상세 보기에서 action frequency, sizing mapping, limitation을 제공한다.
- available한 provider에서 13×13 preflop range matrix를 제공한다.
- 기존 모바일 레이아웃과 hidden-information 정책을 유지한다.

## UX 제안

### 1단계: 요약 카드

- Hand/decision
- `내 선택`
- `추천 선택`
- grade
- `EV loss: -0.28BB` 또는 `EV 미지원`
- `평가 불가`일 때 이유

### 2단계: 근거

- position/effective stack/pot/to-call
- action별 frequency
- available한 action EV
- original sizing과 provider size mapping
- provider/version/abstraction
- limitations

### 3단계: Range

- 13×13 matrix
- action별 frequency 표시
- 선택한 combo 강조
- keyboard/touch 접근성

## Feedback timing

- tournament/play mode: 기본 `hand-end`
- training/drill mode: 기본 `immediate`, 설정 가능

피드백이 다음 미완료 action의 hidden 정보나 상대 policy를 노출해서는 안 됩니다.

## 변경 후보

- `server/public/app.js`
- `server/public/index.html`
- `server/public/style.css`
- UI snapshot/publish envelope schema
- DOM과 분리된 evaluation view-model helper
- 관련 server/publish contract tests

## 완료 조건

- [ ] graded/ungraded/EV-null 상태를 서로 다르게 표시한다.
- [ ] EV가 없는 평가에 숫자를 만들지 않는다.
- [ ] mixed frequency를 단일 정답처럼 오해시키지 않는다.
- [ ] size mapping과 limitation을 상세 화면에서 확인할 수 있다.
- [ ] provider/version/abstraction이 노출된다.
- [ ] available한 데이터에서 range matrix가 정확히 렌더링된다.
- [ ] 선택 combo와 실제 action이 강조된다.
- [ ] 모바일 416px급 화면에서 table/action bar가 붕괴하지 않는다.
- [ ] keyboard focus와 screen-reader label을 제공한다.
- [ ] hand 종료 전 상대 홀카드·실제 archetype·policy가 노출되지 않는다.
- [ ] 기존 coach/review overlay가 회귀하지 않는다.
- [ ] `node --test`가 통과한다.

## 필수 테스트

- graded/ungraded/EV-null view model
- mixed action frequency formatting
- size mapping/limitation rendering
- range matrix combo mapping
- stale decision evaluation 미표시
- hidden data absence
- mobile overflow/seat overlap 회귀
- review/coach snapshot 호환

## 범위 밖

- solver tree explorer 전체 구현
- postflop range heatmap
- 외부 서비스 iframe/embed

items.title: [Duplicate of #25] [Exploit] 숨겨진 상대 정책 기반 Exploit Trainer와 GTO/Exploit 이중 점수를 추가한다
items.body:
## 배경

GTO 학습만으로는 실제 상대의 반복적인 실수를 최대한 공략하는 능력을 측정하기 어렵습니다. 반대로 exploit만 가르치면 사용자가 스스로 큰 빈틈을 만들 수 있습니다.

따라서 동일 decision에 대해 다음 두 질문을 분리해야 합니다.

1. **GTO baseline 관점에서 내 선택은 얼마나 안전한가?**
2. **이 특정 상대 정책을 알고 있을 때 더 높은 EV의 대응이 있었는가?**

## 선행 조건

- #20 preflop reference evaluator
- #21 Skill Profile
- #23 deterministic opponent policy

## 목표

- 상대의 policy/archetype을 게임 중 숨긴 채 플레이
- 충분한 관찰 표본 뒤 사용자에게 상대 read를 입력하게 함
- 세션 종료 후 실제 policy와 deviation 공개
- 각 사용자 decision에 대해 GTO 평가와 exploit 평가를 별도로 저장
- `GTO Score`와 `Exploit Score`를 분리 표시

## 중요한 정확성 원칙

단순 heuristic을 `best response EV`라고 부르지 않습니다.

### 허용되는 출력

1. **solver/precomputed nodelock 데이터가 있는 경우**
   - `exploitEvLossBb`
   - `bestResponseAction`
   - `Exploit Score`

2. **정책 방향만 알고 EV 데이터가 없는 경우**
   - `guidanceStatus: heuristic`
   - `thinValueUp`, `bluffDown` 같은 방향성 코멘트
   - EV/score는 `null`

모든 exploit dataset은 baseline dataset과 동일하게 assumptions, policyVersion, source/provenance, checksum을 가져야 합니다.

## 지원 범위 제안

Phase 1:

- 6-max 100BB preflop
- heads-up decision branch만 평가
- 고정 policy set: Nit, CallingStation, LAG/Maniac
- policy-conditioned precomputed reference가 있는 spot만 exploit EV 제공

Phase 2:

- selected postflop heads-up spots
- nodelock/solver adapter 연결

## 평가 결과 예시

```json
{
  "decisionId": "...",
  "gto": {
    "status": "evaluated",
    "evLossBb": 0.03,
    "grade": "inaccuracy"
  },
  "exploit": {
    "status": "evaluated",
    "opponentPolicyId": "calling-station-v1",
    "referenceId": "br-calling-station-v1",
    "bestAction": "raise",
    "evLossBb": 0.31,
    "grade": "mistake"
  },
  "interpretation": "GTO상 허용되지만 이 상대에게는 value를 놓친 선택"
}
```

게임 중에는 `opponentPolicyId`와 exploit reference를 공개하지 않습니다. UI에는 선택 후 GTO feedback만 즉시 보여주고, exploit 세부 결과는 모드 설정에 따라 세션 종료 후 공개합니다.

## 상대 읽기 입력

표본이 너무 적을 때 archetype을 맞히는 게임이 되지 않도록 최소 관찰량을 둡니다.

예:

```json
{
  "playerId": "p2",
  "submittedAtHand": 30,
  "read": {
    "archetype": "CallingStation",
    "foldTooMuch": false,
    "callsTooMuch": true,
    "raisesTooMuch": false,
    "confidence": 0.7
  }
}
```

- read 제출 후 소급 수정 여부를 정책으로 고정
- 실제 policy reveal 전까지만 제출 가능
- score는 archetype 이름 일치 하나가 아니라 방향성 deviation과 confidence calibration을 함께 평가

## 세션 결과

```text
GTO Score                  89
Exploit Score              63
Opponent Read Calibration  76

핵심 해석:
- baseline 균형은 대체로 유지
- Calling Station 상대로 river/preflop thin value 부족
- bluff 감소 방향은 잘 읽었으나 적용 빈도가 낮음
```

점수 산식과 분모는 machine-readable report에 버전과 함께 저장합니다.

## 관련 파일

### 수정

- `tools/game-loop.js`
  - exploit mode bootstrap/config
  - policy identity 비공개 유지
  - decision별 이중 평가 orchestration
  - 종료 review 입력에 reveal/evaluation 추가
- `engine/views.js`
  - public view와 final reveal 경계
- `engine/game-archive.js`
  - read submission/evaluation archive
- `publish-contract.js`
  - read form, final reveal, dual score payload
- `tools/publish.js`
- `server/server.js`
- `server/public/app.js`
- `server/public/index.html`
- `server/public/style.css`
- `README.md`
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`

### 신규

- `strategy/exploit/schema.js`
- `strategy/exploit/reference-loader.js`
- `strategy/exploit/evaluator.js`
- `strategy/exploit/datasets/<reference-id>/metadata.json`
- `analytics/opponent-read.js`
- `analytics/exploit-report.js`

### 신규 테스트 후보

- `test/exploit-reference-loader.test.js`
- `test/exploit-evaluator.test.js`
- `test/opponent-read.test.js`
- `test/exploit-privacy.test.js`
- `test/exploit-report.test.js`

## 완료 조건

- [ ] GTO와 exploit evaluation이 서로 다른 필드/strategy id를 가진다.
- [ ] exploit 데이터가 없는 spot은 heuristic 또는 unsupported이며 EV/score를 만들지 않는다.
- [ ] solver-generated/precomputed reference만 `best response`와 EV 표현을 사용한다.
- [ ] 게임 중 policyId, archetype, deviation 수치가 public snapshot/coach에 노출되지 않는다.
- [ ] 최소 관찰 표본 전에는 opponent read 제출 또는 score 확정을 제한한다.
- [ ] read 제출 시점과 수정 정책이 archive에 남는다.
- [ ] GTO Score가 높고 Exploit Score가 낮은 사례를 올바르게 표현한다.
- [ ] 칩 결과가 dual score를 직접 바꾸지 않는다.
- [ ] score 산식, threshold, dataset version이 report에 저장된다.
- [ ] actual policy reveal과 사용자의 read 평가는 종합 리뷰에서 분리된다.
- [ ] policy/evaluator 오류가 실제 게임 종료와 archive를 막지 않는다.

## 범위 밖

- 실시간 opponent model ML
- 온라인 플레이어 추적
- 사용자별 클라우드 population model
- unsupported postflop nodelock의 EV 추정

Roadmap: #17

items.title: [Duplicate of #22] [Analytics] 학습 통계·EV Loss/100·persistent Skill Profile과 Leak Detector를 추가한다
items.body:
## 배경

현재 `engine/hand.js`의 raw stats와 `engine/views.js::statsReport()`는 다음 지표를 제공합니다.

- hands/sample
- VPIP
- PFR
- AF
- showdown win
- net

이는 테이블 성향을 보는 데는 유용하지만, **어느 포지션/spot에서 어떤 선택을 얼마나 손해 보며 반복하는지**를 알려주지 못합니다. 또한 `review.md`의 `다음 게임에서 연습할 것`은 자연어로 전달되어 여러 세션의 숙련도를 안정적으로 누적하기 어렵습니다.

## 선행 조건

- #19 canonical DecisionContext
- #20 reference strategy evaluator

## 목표

1. 결과와 분리된 machine-readable session learning report 생성
2. 여러 게임에 걸쳐 누적되는 persistent Skill Profile
3. sample/confidence를 고려한 Leak Detector
4. 구조화된 practice focus를 다음 게임/드릴에 전달

## 아키텍처 원칙

- `engine/hand.js`에는 포커 규칙에 필요한 최소 raw event/count만 둡니다.
- position/spot/EV 기반 학습 통계는 hand archive의 `decisions[]`와 `evaluations[]`에서 파생합니다.
- 칩 net과 decision EV loss를 같은 점수로 섞지 않습니다.
- unsupported decision은 분모와 지원률에 명시적으로 반영하며 0 loss로 취급하지 않습니다.
- 작은 표본의 leak을 확정적으로 표현하지 않습니다.

## Session Learning Report 예시

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "sessionId": "...",
  "strategyId": "6max-100bb-norake-v1",
  "decisions": {
    "total": 82,
    "evaluated": 68,
    "unsupported": 14,
    "supportRate": 0.829
  },
  "grades": {
    "correct": 52,
    "inaccuracy": 9,
    "mistake": 6,
    "blunder": 1
  },
  "ev": {
    "totalLossBb": 5.83,
    "lossBbPer100EvaluatedDecisions": 8.57
  },
  "dimensions": {
    "preflop.rfi.BTN": {
      "sample": 14,
      "evaluated": 14,
      "evLossBb": 0.41,
      "accuracy": 0.86
    },
    "preflop.bbDefense.vsBTN": {
      "sample": 11,
      "evaluated": 10,
      "evLossBb": 2.31,
      "accuracy": 0.50
    }
  }
}
```

`EV Loss/100`의 분모는 **EV가 실제로 존재하는 evaluated decisions**로 명확히 정의합니다.

## Persistent Skill Profile 예시

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "profileId": "default",
  "updatedAt": "...",
  "strategyIds": ["6max-100bb-norake-v1"],
  "lifetime": { "...": "..." },
  "rolling": {
    "last100": { "...": "..." },
    "last500": { "...": "..." }
  },
  "skills": {
    "preflop.rfi.BTN": {
      "mastery": 91,
      "sample": 44,
      "confidence": 0.78,
      "lastPracticedAt": "..."
    }
  },
  "leaks": [
    {
      "id": "PREFLOP_BB_DEFENSE_VS_BTN_OVERFOLD",
      "dimension": "preflop.bbDefense.vsBTN",
      "severity": 0.84,
      "confidence": 0.73,
      "sample": 28,
      "evidenceDecisionIds": ["..."]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Profile 저장

- runtime `game/`과 분리된 gitignored user-data 디렉터리를 사용합니다.
- 기본 후보: `data/profiles/default.json`
- CLI에서 `--profile-dir`로 override 가능하게 합니다.
- atomic tmp-write-rename, schema version, migration을 적용합니다.
- archive/review 삭제와 무관하게 profile이 유지되어야 합니다.

## Leak Detector 규칙

초기에는 설명 가능한 deterministic rule로 시작합니다.

- 최소 evaluated sample 미만이면 leak 생성 금지
- EV loss, 반복 빈도, 최근성, confidence를 함께 사용
- 한 번의 큰 결과보다 반복되는 decision error를 우선
- 예: BB vs BTN overfold, BTN RFI under-open, 3-bet underuse
- evidence decision id를 남겨 사용자가 원본 핸드로 이동 가능

자연어 모델이 새로운 leak id나 severity 숫자를 임의 생성하지 않습니다.

## practiceFocus 구조화

현재 `.practice-focus.json`에 자연어만 전달하는 흐름을 다음처럼 확장합니다.

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "generatedFromProfileAt": "...",
  "focus": [
    {
      "dimension": "preflop.bbDefense.vsBTN",
      "reason": "highest_confident_ev_loss",
      "targetShare": 0.5
    }
  ]
}
```

코치와 Drill은 동일한 focus 객체를 읽고, UI용 한글 설명은 별도로 생성합니다.

## 관련 파일

### 수정

- `engine/views.js`
  - 기존 table stats와 learning stats의 명칭/계약 분리
- `tools/game-loop.js`
  - 세션 완료 시 learning report 생성
  - evaluator/synthesizer prompt에 structured report 제공
  - 다음 게임 practiceFocus 생성
- `engine/game-archive.js`
  - session learning report archive
- `.gitignore`
  - user-data/profile 디렉터리 제외
- `.agents/skills/start-game/SKILL.md`
  - profile/practice focus 경로와 resume 규칙
- `README.md`
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `server/public/app.js`
- `server/public/index.html`
- `server/public/style.css`

### 신규

- `analytics/schema.js`
- `analytics/session-report.js`
- `analytics/skill-profile.js`
- `analytics/leak-detector.js`
- `analytics/practice-focus.js`
- `data/profiles/.gitkeep` 또는 실행 시 생성 방식

### 신규 테스트 후보

- `test/session-learning-report.test.js`
- `test/skill-profile.test.js`
- `test/leak-detector.test.js`
- `test/practice-focus.test.js`

## 완료 조건

- [ ] session report가 raw decisions/evaluations에서 재생성 가능하다.
- [ ] total/evaluated/unsupported 분모가 명확하고 supportRate가 표시된다.
- [ ] EV가 없는 decision을 0 loss로 계산하지 않는다.
- [ ] position/spot별 sample, grade, EV loss를 제공한다.
- [ ] lifetime과 rolling window 통계를 구분한다.
- [ ] strategyId가 다른 평가를 무조건 하나의 수치로 합치지 않는다.
- [ ] minimum sample/confidence 미만에서는 leak을 확정하지 않는다.
- [ ] leak마다 근거 decision id가 존재한다.
- [ ] profile update가 atomic하며 중단 후 이전 파일이 손상되지 않는다.
- [ ] 오래된 schema를 migration하거나 명시적으로 거부한다.
- [ ] 자연어 review가 실패해도 machine report와 profile은 보존된다.
- [ ] 칩 net이 좋다는 이유로 높은 EV loss를 숨기지 않는다.
- [ ] 30핸드 미만 참고용 고지가 기존 review 계약과 일치한다.

## 범위 밖

- spaced repetition scheduler
- postflop solver metrics
- cloud account/profile sync

items.title: [Duplicate of #25] [Phase 3] GTO 점수와 상대별 Exploit 점수를 분리하는 평가기·훈련 모드 구현
items.body:
상위 로드맵: #36
선행: #43, #51

## 배경

GTO 평가는 균형 전략에 대한 손실을 보여 주지만, 실제 상대가 체계적으로 overfold/overcall/underbluff하는 경우 가장 수익적인 대응은 GTO baseline과 다를 수 있습니다.

현재 종합 리뷰는 종료 후 실제 archetype을 공개하고 사용자의 read를 정성적으로 평가할 수 있지만, “GTO적으로는 괜찮았으나 이 상대에게는 놓친 exploit” 또는 “GTO에서 벗어났지만 상대 약점 때문에 더 높은 EV”를 정량적으로 구분하지 못합니다.

## 목표

각 사용자 결정에 대해 가능한 경우 두 가지 기준을 병렬로 계산합니다.

1. **GTO baseline evaluation**
2. **Opponent-specific exploit evaluation**

그리고 세션 수준에서 `GTO Score`와 `Exploit Score`를 별도로 제공합니다.

## 제안 평가 결과

```json
{
  "decisionId": "d-31-river-7",
  "gto": {
    "bestEvBb": 4.1,
    "chosenEvBb": 3.9,
    "evLossBb": 0.2,
    "grade": "inaccuracy"
  },
  "exploit": {
    "policy": {"id":"calling-station-v1","version":"1.0.0"},
    "bestEvBb": 6.8,
    "chosenEvBb": 2.1,
    "evLossBb": 4.7,
    "grade": "blunder",
    "adjustment": "BLUFF_DOWN_VALUE_UP"
  }
}
```

정확한 exploit EV를 계산할 수 없는 단계에서는 숫자를 만들지 않고 `status: unsupported`와 검증 가능한 빈도 deviation만 제공합니다.

## 상대 정보 공개 경계

- 플레이 중에는 실제 policy id와 private parameters를 UI/coach에 노출하지 않는다.
- 사용자가 관찰 가능한 행동 통계만 opponent read panel에 제공할 수 있다.
- 게임 종료 후 synthesizer가 실제 policy와 사용자 추론을 분리해서 비교한다.
- private policy metadata는 `redactRecord()` 및 public publish allowlist에서 제거한다.

## 구현 단계

### 1단계: deviation-aware rule 평가
- overfold spot에서 bluff opportunity 사용 여부
- overcall spot에서 thin value/bluff mix 조정
- underbluff spot에서 bluff-catcher fold 확대
- over-aggression spot에서 trap/call/raise adjustment

### 2단계: nodelock/response model provider
- StrategyProvider와 동일한 versioned interface
- opponent policy를 response model로 주입
- 지원하지 않는 tree는 unsupported

## 변경 대상

- Create: `training/exploit-contract.js`
- Create: `training/exploit-evaluator.js`
- Create: `training/opponent-read.js`
- Modify: `opponents/policy-contract.js`
- Modify: `tools/training-cli.js`
- Modify: `tools/game-loop.js`
- Modify: final evaluator/synthesizer prompt
- Modify: structured feedback UI와 review UI
- Test: 새 `test/exploit-evaluator.test.js`
- Test: 새 `test/opponent-read.test.js`
- Test: 새 `test/exploit-privacy.test.js`

## 완료 조건

- [ ] GTO와 Exploit evaluation이 같은 필드로 덮어써지지 않는다.
- [ ] opponent policy/version이 명시되지 않으면 exploit 수치를 생성하지 않는다.
- [ ] 플레이 중 private policy/archetype이 public snapshot, coach, SSE history에 노출되지 않는다.
- [ ] 종료 리뷰에서 실제 policy, 관찰 통계, 사용자 read, 권장 exploit을 분리한다.
- [ ] GTO score가 높고 exploit score가 낮은 사례와 반대 사례를 fixture로 검증한다.
- [ ] 단순한 결과(net win/loss)가 두 점수를 바꾸지 않는다.
- [ ] 표본이 적을 때 opponent read confidence를 낮게 표시한다.
- [ ] policy version 변경 시 과거 exploit evaluation과 혼합하지 않는다.
- [ ] unsupported spot에서 heuristic 숫자를 생성하지 않는다.

## 범위 제외

- 실전 온라인 포커 클라이언트 연동
- 실시간 opponent tracking 서비스
- 무제한 임의 nodelock tree 계산

분석 문서: https://github.com/Sungmin-Cho/AI-Holdem/blob/docs/gto-learning-roadmap/docs/design/2026-08-31-holdem-learning-roadmap.md

items.title: [Duplicate of #24] [Phase 3] AI Persona와 실행 Strategy Policy를 분리하고 빈도를 검증 가능하게 만들기
items.body:
상위 로드맵: #36
선행: #41, #43

## 배경

현재 `engine/personas.js`는 TAG/LAG/Nit/CallingStation/Maniac/Trickster에 bluffFreq, threeBetFreq, tiltProne을 부여하고, `tools/player-prompt.md`가 이 값을 LLM 플레이어에게 전달합니다.

이 값은 행동 힌트이지 실행 계약이 아닙니다. 예를 들어 `threeBetFreq: 0.30`이 실제 해당 opportunity의 30%에서 3-bet을 발생시킨다는 보장이 없고, prompt/model/version에 따라 분포가 달라질 수 있습니다. 따라서 특정 상대 약점을 반복 연습하거나 exploit EV를 계산하기 어렵습니다.

## 목표

AI의 표현 계층과 전략 실행 계층을 분리합니다.

- **Persona:** 이름, 말투, 성격, 공개 연출
- **Policy:** 상태를 받아 action distribution을 반환하는 versioned 전략
- LLM 플레이어는 계속 선택 가능한 adapter로 유지
- Training/Exploit Mode에서는 deterministic policy player를 선택 가능

## 제안 인터페이스

```js
export function getActionDistribution(context, policy) {
  return {
    policy: { id: 'calling-station-v1', version: '1.0.0' },
    spotKey: '...',
    actions: [
      { action: 'fold', probability: 0.18 },
      { action: 'call', probability: 0.74 },
      { action: 'raise', probability: 0.08, sizingBb: 9 }
    ]
  };
}
```

실제 action sampling은 seedable RNG를 사용하고 decision record에 policy id/version, distribution digest, sample seed/roll을 private metadata로 남깁니다. 이 metadata는 종합 리뷰 전 public payload에 노출하지 않습니다.

## 아키텍처

`tools/player-runtime.js`는 LLM CLI adapter라는 기존 책임을 유지합니다. 그 파일에 deterministic policy를 섞지 않습니다.

제안 구조:

```text
opponents/
  policy-contract.js
  policy-player.js
  profiles/
    tag.js
    lag.js
    nit.js
    calling-station.js
    maniac.js
    trickster.js

tools/
  opponent-controller.js
```

`tools/opponent-controller.js`가 LLM adapter와 Policy player 중 하나를 선택하고 `tools/game-loop.js`에 동일한 decision 결과 계약을 제공합니다.

## 변경 대상

- Create: `opponents/policy-contract.js`
- Create: `opponents/policy-player.js`
- Create: `opponents/profiles/*.js`
- Create: `tools/opponent-controller.js`
- Modify: `engine/personas.js`
- Modify: `tools/player-prompt.md`
- Modify: `tools/game-loop.js`
- Modify: `engine/game-archive.js`
- Modify: `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `README.md`
- Test: 새 `test/policy-player.test.js`
- Test: 새 `test/opponent-controller.test.js`
- Test: `test/personas.test.js`
- Test: 필요한 최소 경계만 `test/game-loop.test.js`

## 완료 조건

- [ ] Persona 데이터에서 전략 빈도와 tilt 실행 로직을 제거하거나 명확히 presentation-only로 표시한다.
- [ ] Policy contract가 legal action 밖의 결과를 만들 수 없다.
- [ ] 동일 seed/context/policy version은 동일 action을 생성한다.
- [ ] 통계 fixture에서 각 profile의 opportunity-conditioned 빈도가 허용 오차 안에 들어온다.
- [ ] RFI, 3-bet, fold-to-cbet, river call 등 빈도는 opportunity 분모를 정확히 정의한다.
- [ ] Policy metadata는 game 종료 전 사용자 public view에 노출되지 않는다.
- [ ] final review에서 실제 policy와 사용자의 read를 비교할 수 있다.
- [ ] LLM opponent mode는 기존 session/watchdog/containment 계약과 호환된다.
- [ ] Policy mode에서는 불필요한 LLM player session을 만들지 않는다.
- [ ] crash/resume 시 policy RNG sequence가 조용히 바뀌지 않는다.

## 범위 제외

- 이 이슈에서는 사용자 exploit 점수를 계산하지 않는다.
- 완전한 GTO bot 구현은 범위가 아니다. 상대 누수를 반복 가능하게 만드는 것이 목적이다.

분석 문서: https://github.com/Sungmin-Cho/AI-Holdem/blob/docs/gto-learning-roadmap/docs/design/2026-08-31-holdem-learning-roadmap.md

items.title: [Duplicate of #18] [Phase 0] 고정 6-max 100BB Training Mode와 게임 설정 계약 추가
items.body:
상위 로드맵: #36

## 배경

현재 게임은 `engine/hand.js`에서 기본 스택 5000, 블라인드 25/50, `levelEvery=8`을 사용하고 `BASE_BLINDS`에 따라 블라인드가 상승합니다. 이 구성은 플레이 경험에는 적합하지만, 동일한 조건의 spot을 반복하고 세션 간 성과를 비교해야 하는 GTO 훈련에는 변수가 너무 많습니다.

`engine/cli.js init`과 `tools/game-loop.js`도 `--stack`, `--blinds`, `--level-every`를 개별 옵션으로만 전달하며 명시적인 게임 모드와 설정 schema가 없습니다.

## 목표

기존 토너먼트형 Play Mode를 보존하면서 다음의 통제된 Training Mode를 추가합니다.

- 기본 6-max: 사용자 1명 + AI 5명
- 시작 유효 스택 100BB
- 블라인드 고정
- ante 없음
- 학습 세션 동안 탈락/블라인드 상승에 의해 환경이 달라지지 않음
- 모드와 설정을 상태·아카이브·리뷰에서 재현 가능

## 제안 계약

```json
{
  "mode": "play|training",
  "tableSize": 6,
  "startingStackBb": 100,
  "blinds": [50, 100],
  "blindSchedule": "progressive|fixed",
  "ante": 0,
  "strategyProfile": "cash-6max-100bb-v1"
}
```

CLI는 우선 `--mode play|training`을 추가하고, `training` 기본값은 위 profile 하나로 제한합니다. 임의 stack-depth 조합은 Strategy Provider가 지원하기 전까지 열지 않습니다.

## 변경 대상

- Modify: `engine/hand.js`
- Modify: `engine/cli.js`
- Modify: `engine/game-archive.js`
- Modify: `engine/views.js`
- Modify: `tools/game-loop.js`
- Modify: `.agents/skills/start-game/SKILL.md`
- Modify: `README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`
- Test: `test/hand-setup.test.js`
- Test: `test/cli.test.js`
- Test: `test/game-loop.test.js` 또는 새 `test/training-mode.test.js`

## 완료 조건

- [ ] 기존 옵션 없는 시작은 현재 Play Mode 동작과 완전히 호환된다.
- [ ] `--mode training`은 6-max/100BB/fixed blind 설정을 원자적으로 만든다.
- [ ] `state.config`에 mode/profile이 schema-versioned 형태로 저장된다.
- [ ] `lastHand`와 hand archive만으로 해당 핸드의 학습 환경을 식별할 수 있다.
- [ ] Training Mode에서는 `level`과 블라인드가 핸드 수에 따라 증가하지 않는다.
- [ ] Training Mode의 세션 종료 규칙을 명시하고 테스트한다. 초기 구현에서는 사용자가 중단할 때까지 지속하거나 정해진 hand count로 종료한다.
- [ ] 잘못된 mode/profile 조합은 `USAGE`로 fail-closed한다.
- [ ] README와 start-game skill에 실행 예제가 추가된다.
- [ ] `node --test`와 `npm run test:ci`가 통과한다.

## 범위 제외

- MTT ante/ICM
- 여러 stack depth를 동시에 지원하는 solver matrix
- Drill 전용 UI

분석 문서: https://github.com/Sungmin-Cho/AI-Holdem/blob/docs/gto-learning-roadmap/docs/design/2026-08-31-holdem-learning-roadmap.md

items.title: [Duplicate of #24] [P1] AI persona와 실제 전략 policy를 분리해 재현 가능한 훈련 상대를 만든다
items.body:
## 배경

현재 `engine/personas.js`는 TAG/LAG/Nit/CallingStation/Maniac/Trickster archetype에 `bluffFreq`, `threeBetFreq`, `tiltProne` 값을 부여하고, `tools/player-prompt.md`가 이 값을 LLM 플레이어에게 전달합니다.

하지만 이 숫자는 프롬프트 힌트일 뿐 실제 장기 행동 빈도를 보장하지 않습니다. 같은 모델도 세션·문맥·표현에 따라 전략이 달라질 수 있어, 특정 약점을 반복 공략하는 exploit 학습의 기준 상대가 되기 어렵습니다.

정밀 분석 문서: [docs/GTO_LEARNING_ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/Sungmin-Cho/AI-Holdem/blob/docs/gto-learning-roadmap/docs/GTO_LEARNING_ROADMAP.md)

## 목표

AI의 **캐릭터 표현(persona)** 과 **의사결정 전략(policy)** 을 분리합니다.

- persona: 이름, 말투, 성격, 공개 연출
- policy: baseline strategy, deviation, size preference, seeded sampling

기존 LLM 플레이어 모드는 그대로 보존하고, training mode에서는 deterministic/seeded policy actor를 선택할 수 있게 합니다.

## 제안 구조

```text
engine/personas.js              # 표현 정보만
strategy/policies/
  schema.js
  baseline-policy.js
  deviation-policy.js
  sample-action.js
  profiles/
    tag.json
    lag.json
    nit.json
    calling-station.json
    maniac.json
    trickster.json

tools/
  policy-player.js              # sidecar actor adapter
```

## policy 처리 흐름

```text
canonical decision snapshot
  -> baseline strategy provider
  -> archetype deviation transform
  -> legal action/size 재검증
  -> seeded weighted sample
  -> engine step
```

LLM은 training policy 모드에서 액션을 결정하지 않습니다. 필요하면 액션 결정 후 별도 table-talk 문장만 생성할 수 있으나, table talk 실패가 게임 액션을 지연시키면 안 됩니다.

## policy profile 예시

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "id": "calling-station-v1",
  "baseline": "gto-pack-id",
  "deviations": [
    {"spotFamily": "PREFLOP.VS_RFI", "action": "fold", "multiplier": 0.70},
    {"spotFamily": "RIVER.BLUFF_CATCH", "action": "call", "multiplier": 1.50}
  ],
  "sizePreferences": {"small": 0.6, "large": 0.4},
  "seedPolicy": "session+player+decision"
}
```

빈도 변환 후에는 0~1 clamp와 renormalization을 수행하고, legal action에 없는 항목은 제거합니다.

## actor abstraction

현재 `tools/game-loop.js`는 `playerAdapter.decide()`와 persistent LLM session에 직접 의존합니다. 다음 공통 인터페이스를 도입합니다.

```js
actor.decide({ playerId, decisionId, message, snapshot, timeoutMs })
// -> { action, amount?, source, diagnostics }
```

- `llmActor`: 현재 player-runtime adapter 래핑

items.body:
Parent/controller: #8107
Train: #8539 (T7.9)
Depends on: the maintained-denominator/Linux-baseline child under #8107
Feeds: #8005, #8002, #7726, #7942

## Objective

Execute the maintained LSP4IJ denominator on native macOS arm64 and retain platform-specific application/runtime, path, permission, archive, process, install, LSP, optional DAP, and cleanup results independently.

## Builder packet

- **Writer slot:** B or dedicated macOS host lane
- **Conflict key:** `lsp4ij-envelope-macos`
- **PR title:** `test: prove LSP4IJ macOS arm64 row (#<issue>)`
- **Expected size:** S–M
- **Claim ceiling:** exact macOS arm64 row

## Acceptance

- [ ] Exact macOS version, arm64 architecture, IDE application/JBR/LSP4IJ/template/binary subjects are bound.
- [ ] The same core LSP denominator used by the baseline is replayed; client-hidden cells remain local.
- [ ] Application paths, executable permissions/quarantine disposition, Unicode paths, archive extraction, process hierarchy, and cleanup are directly observed.
- [ ] Managed-install claims consume the exact macOS arm64 artifact and cannot inherit x86_64 or Linux.
- [ ] Optional DAP cells use exact DAP receipts and remain separate from LSP.
- [ ] A second exact run is comparable.
- [ ] macOS does not promote another platform, architecture, IDE product, or plugin version.

## Negative controls

Fail when Rosetta/x86_64 substitutes for native arm64 without an explicit separate row, another platform fills the cell, quarantine/permission failure is hidden, a version string replaces identity, or cleanup is unknown.

## Stop conditions

Record unavailable/not-proven when no suitable runner exists. Do not relabel a local manual observation as automated maintained-envelope evidence.

items.title: [Duplicate of #21] [UI/Coach] 선택→권장→EV 손실→근거→Range로 이어지는 결정 리뷰 UI를 만든다
items.body:
## 배경

현재 코치 공개 계약은 사실상 핸드별 짧은 자연어 `text`와 `overfold`/`unavailable` 상태입니다. 이는 빠른 피드백에는 좋지만 다음을 직접 검증하기 어렵습니다.

- 내가 정확히 어떤 액션을 선택했는가
- reference strategy의 action mix는 무엇인가
- EV loss와 grade는 무엇인가
- 어떤 공개 정보가 판정 근거인가
- 전체 169 range에서 이 핸드는 어디에 위치하는가

또한 `publish-contract.js`에는 body 상한이 있으므로 여러 결정의 전체 range matrix를 한 번에 SSE snapshot에 싣는 설계는 피해야 합니다.

## 선행 조건

- #19 DecisionContext
- #20 strategy evaluation

## 목표

자연어 코치와 별도로 machine-readable `decisionReviews`를 공개하고, UI에서 다음 3단계로 탐색하게 합니다.

1. **결과 요약** — 선택, 권장, grade, EV loss
2. **왜?** — position/pot odds/action history 등 공개 근거
3. **Range** — 해당 spot의 169-hand action mix

## 공개 payload 제안

```json
{
  "decisionReviews": [
    {
      "schemaVersion": 1,
      "decisionId": "...",
      "handNo": 12,
      "street": "preflop",
      "spotKey": "...",
      "strategyId": "6max-100bb-norake-v1",
      "status": "evaluated",
      "heroHandClass": "AJo",
      "chosenAction": "fold",
      "recommendedAction": "raise_2.5",
      "chosenFrequency": 0.04,
      "evLossBb": 0.28,
      "grade": "mistake",
      "evidence": {
        "position": "BTN",
        "effectiveStackBb": 100,
        "sequence": "unopened"
      },
      "rangeRef": "<strategyId>/<spot-id>"
    }
  ]
}
```

자연어 `coach`는 이 객체를 설명할 수 있지만 수치의 정본은 `decisionReviews`입니다.

## 노출 시점

### Full game

- 현재 hand가 끝난 뒤 해당 hand의 decision review 공개
- 같은 hand 진행 중에는 이후 결정에 영향을 줄 수 있는 range/상대 정보를 노출하지 않음

### Drill

- 사용자가 문제에 응답한 직후 공개
- 응답 전 snapshot에는 answer payload와 `rangeRef`를 싣지 않음

## Range lazy loading

169 matrix 전체를 모든 review와 함께 publish하지 않습니다.

제안:

1. sidecar/strategy loader가 허용된 public range artifact를 생성
2. public payload에는 검증된 opaque `rangeRef`만 포함
3. 사용자가 Range 패널을 열 때 token-protected read-only endpoint로 요청
4. server는 whitelisted artifact directory만 읽고 path traversal/symlink를 거부

예:

```text
game/public-strategy/
  <digest>.json
```

artifact에는 opponent private information이나 current-hand hidden data를 넣지 않습니다. dataset의 public reference mix만 포함합니다.

## UI 구성

### 카드 요약

```text
BTN · AJo · Unopened · 100BB
내 선택: Fold
권장: Raise 2.5BB (96%)
Mistake · -0.28BB
```

### Why 패널

- Decision 당시 공개 정보
- chosen action과 alternative EV
- grade threshold 설명
- unsupported이면 정확한 이유
- LLM 설명은 “AI 설명”으로 구분하고 machine 수치와 충돌 시 수치를 우선

### Range 패널

- 13×13 matrix
- 각 cell에 fold/call/raise mixed frequency
- 현재 hero hand 강조
- 색만으로 의미를 전달하지 않고 text/aria label 제공
- keyboard navigation 지원

## 관련 파일

### 수정

- `publish-contract.js`
  - `decisionReviews`, `rangeRef` schema/size validation
- `tools/publish.js`
  - 공개 필드 allowlist와 retry/digest 계약
- `tools/game-loop.js`
  - hand 종료 후 evaluation/coach 결합 및 publish
  - public range artifact 생성/정리
- `server/server.js`
  - token-protected range artifact read endpoint
  - path traversal/symlink/hardlink 방어
- `server/public/app.js`
  - review list, detail, lazy range fetch/render
- `server/public/index.html`
  - semantic dialog/panel markup
- `server/public/style.css`
  - grade/range/responsive/accessibility
- `engine/game-archive.js`
  - public artifact와 evaluation archive 정책
- `README.md`
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`

### 신규

- `strategy/public-range.js`
- `test/decision-review-contract.test.js`
- `test/public-range-endpoint.test.js`
- `test/range-matrix-ui.test.js` 또는 DOM fixture 기반 테스트

### 회귀 테스트

- 기존 publish/server/turn contract 테스트
- `test/game-loop.test.js`

## 완료 조건

- [ ] 자연어 coach와 machine-readable decisionReviews가 분리된다.
- [ ] UI 수치는 evaluator JSON에서만 가져온다.
- [ ] full game에서는 hand 종료 전 decision answer/range가 공개되지 않는다.
- [ ] drill에서는 응답 전 answer payload가 공개되지 않는다.
- [ ] unsupported/error 상태를 EV 0 또는 correct로 표시하지 않는다.
- [ ] range matrix는 lazy load되어 publish body 상한을 위반하지 않는다.
- [ ] `rangeRef`는 opaque digest/id이고 사용자가 임의 경로를 요청할 수 없다.
- [ ] range endpoint는 token, allowlist, regular-file, path identity를 검증한다.
- [ ] current hero hand가 matrix에서 정확히 강조된다.
- [ ] mixed frequencies와 grade를 색 외 텍스트/aria label로도 읽을 수 있다.
- [ ] 모바일 UI에서 table/action bar를 가리지 않고 리뷰를 탐색할 수 있다.
- [ ] LLM 코치가 실패해도 기계 판정 UI는 표시된다.
- [ ] 기존 `coach`/`review` snapshot과 resume/retry publication이 회귀하지 않는다.

## 범위 밖

- postflop combo-level range visualization
- 실시간 상대 range 추정
- 외부 CDN에 strategy data 게시

Roadmap: #17

items.title: [DUPLICATE of #545] Converge extensions on Agent Skills + official MCP SDK/Registry
items.body:
## Verified current state

On product-surface head `d8a8e8282e9650579561a7cadef4d861a6e396a7`:

- `gateway.skill_registry` is a real, useful disk-skill primitive and the native UI exposes skills/tools.
- It currently uses a home-grown frontmatter parser rather than the Agent Skills specification.
- `gateway.plugin_registry` has **0 production plugin registrations** in the restored runtime; it is a custom package/toggle shell, not an ecosystem.
- `gateway.mcp_tool_bridge` explicitly says full MCP protocol support is future work. `list_tools()` is config-backed, and `invoke()` manually launches a process and writes one `tools/call` JSON-RPC payload without implementing the MCP client lifecycle/initialization contract.
- Restored runtime had **0 configured MCP servers / 0 MCP LLM tool schemas**.

## Current upstream reality (2026-08-19)

- Agent Skills now has an open `SKILL.md` specification with progressive disclosure and standard metadata/optional `scripts`, `references`, and `assets` directories.
- The official MCP Registry provides standardized `server.json` metadata for discovery/install/configuration and versioned server records.
- The official MCP Python SDK already implements stdio and Streamable HTTP clients, protocol negotiation/lifecycle, tool/resource/prompt discovery, auth hooks, and standard message handling.
- The Agent Skills `skills-ref` library labels itself demonstration-only; use it for conformance/reference, not as Kitty production infrastructure.

## Decision direction

**ADOPT standards; delete custom protocol/package plumbing where it stops adding personal value.**

1. KEEP the concept of Kitty's skill discovery/search/activation UX, but make it Agent-Skills-compatible rather than extending the custom frontmatter format.
2. Use a normal YAML parser plus a small spec-validation layer; do not production-depend on `skills-ref`.
3. REPLACE hand-rolled `mcp_tool_bridge` protocol code with the official MCP Python SDK.
4. Consume official MCP Registry `server.json` metadata for public-server discovery/install configuration instead of inventing a Kitty marketplace/catalogue.
5. Treat permissions, enabled/disabled state, trust, health, credentials and installed version as **Kitty-local installation state**, not as a new package format.
6. Re-evaluate `plugin_registry`: with zero registrations and no standard external package format, it should survive only if a concrete Kitty-local grouping capability cannot be represented by installed Skills + MCP servers + local policy records.

## Acceptance before implementation

- One installed Agent Skill can be discovered with standards-compliant metadata and activated progressively.
- One stdio MCP server and one Streamable HTTP server can initialize, list tools and invoke through the official SDK.
- Disabled/archived/unhealthy capabilities are not advertised as available.
- Install/version/permission state is locally durable and does not fork upstream manifests.
- No custom MCP handshake/JSON-RPC transport remains in production.
- No new Kitty-specific marketplace/package schema is introduced without a demonstrated gap in Agent Skills + MCP metadata.

This is an Adopt-Before-Build convergence direction, not an instruction to implement the whole extension platform in one PR.

items.title: Duplicate of #16: packaged launcher/runtime path mismatch
items.body:
## Origin

Blocking finding from the independent final maintainer review of PR #1.

- Base: `main` at `9b2f4f70a0955208fb4ba5c0119d0c4184b030f4`
- Reviewed head: `f5a1ef7d4c5eba07737a1d8ab1c6eea0473fb860`
- Severity: **P2 — merge blocker for v1.1.0**

## Reachable failure

The generated host packages place the launchers and native runtime in different sibling directories, but the POSIX launcher resolves the runtime as though it were inside the launcher directory:

- `plugin-src/claude/generator.json:52-57` copies the launcher to `bin/launch.sh`.
- `plugin-src/claude/generator.json:76` declares `runtime_output` as `runtime`.
- `tools/build_plugins.py:398-405` copies the runtime tree to `<plugin-root>/runtime/...`.
- `src/opensocrates/hosts/claude/commands.py:32-35` invokes `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/launch.sh`.
- `packaging/launchers/launch.sh:77-80` joins `darwin-arm64/...` directly to the launcher's own directory, so it probes `<plugin-root>/bin/darwin-arm64/...` rather than `<plugin-root>/runtime/darwin-arm64/...`.
- `installer/opensocrates.mjs:593-603` independently confirms that the verified package runtime is expected at `<plugin-root>/runtime/darwin-arm64/...`.

On the supported `darwin-arm64` package, every hook therefore takes the `missing_runtime` fail-open branch. For Claude and Codex hook mode, `packaging/launchers/launch.sh:7-12` deliberately emits literal-empty stdout and exits 0, so the defect is silent: `UserPromptSubmit` never reaches selection, and `Stop`/`SessionEnd` never reach artifact cleanup.

## Independent reproduction

A package-shaped temporary tree containing:

```text
plugin/bin/launch.sh
plugin/runtime/linux-x64/opensocrates-runtime/opensocrates-runtime
```

was executed with a marker-writing stub runtime. The current generated layout did **not** invoke the runtime and returned zero bytes on stdout. Moving the same stub to the path the launcher currently probes:

```text
plugin/bin/linux-x64/opensocrates-runtime/opensocrates-runtime
```

made the marker appear. This isolates the failure to the path join rather than runtime behavior.

## Why CI missed it

`tools/release_check.py:1152-1168` checks that launchers exist and are executable, and `tools/release_check.py:1191-1196` checks that the runtime target appears in the release manifest. It does not execute the generated package's actual launcher against the generated package tree. The installer lifecycle fixture similarly creates only `runtime/...` and does not exercise the packaged launcher.

## Acceptance criteria

- Align the launcher lookup and generated package layout for both Claude and Codex without weakening fail-open behavior.
- Add a regression test that executes the **actual generated/package launcher** from `bin/launch.sh` and proves it invokes the runtime in the package tree.
- Cover at least `UserPromptSubmit`, `Stop`, and `SessionEnd` dispatch so automatic selection and cleanup cannot silently become no-ops.
- Make the PR-native package/release gate fail on the current broken layout.
- Re-run exact-head CI and a real generated-package hook cycle before restoring Claude Code CLI automatic-selection claims.

No code was modified during this review.

- `plugin-src/claude/generator.json:76` declares `runtime_output` as `runtime`.

- `src/opensocrates/hosts/claude/commands.py:32-35` invokes `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/launch.sh`.
- `packaging/launchers/launch.sh:77-80` joins `darwin-arm64/...` directly to the launcher's own directory, so it probes `<plugin-root>/bin/darwin-arm64/...` rather than `<plugin-root>/runtime/darwin-arm64/...`.

A package-shaped temporary tree containing:

```text
plugin/runtime/linux-x64/opensocrates-runtime/opensocrates-runtime
```

- Make the PR-native package/release gate fail on the current broken layout.

items.title: [Duplicate] accidental resubmission of #5092 — please ignore
items.body:
## Problem / 问题

Three shipped readers parse `git` machine output with `str.splitlines()`. `splitlines()` treats U+0085 (NEL), U+2028 and U+2029 — plus U+000B, U+000C and U+001C–U+001E (measured; U+001F, the field separator this format itself uses, does not split) — as line breaks, while every `--porcelain` / `--format=` stream uses **LF only** as its record separator and emits the substituted values raw. So one record becomes several fragments, and the loop's own "skip malformed lines" guard silently swallows one of them.

This is the same root cause as #5057, which was fixed for the effect-runtime stderr channel in #5058: a record framed by a separator wider than the one the writer emits.

## Reproduction 1 — a contributor's name is truncated, and the loss is silent

`loopx/capabilities/issue_fix/reviewer_recommendation.py:631` `_collect_history` runs `git log --format=%aN%x1f%aE` (field separator `\x1f`, record separator LF) and frames it at `:650` with `output.splitlines()`, then does `if not separator: continue`.

Measured with a commit whose author name is `Zo` + U+0085 + `e`:

```
raw stdout repr: 'Zo\x85e\x1fz@e.com\n'
records via splitlines(): 2
records via split(LF)   : 1
what the shipped loop sees: [("'Zo'", DROPPED - no separator), ("'e'", "HAS_SEP")]
```

The contributor is therefore published as `e`. That value is not cosmetic: the rows feed the recommendation filter at `:839-850`, where `excluded_author_names` (`:848`) and `_normalise_author_name(row[0])` (`:844`) decide who stays eligible — so a person who was excluded by name can come back as a different string and remain eligible, and their real commits are attributed to a fragment.

## Reproduction 2 — a worktree path is cut, and the wrong directory is written to

`loopx/capabilities/integration_branch/core.py:523` `_worktree_for_branch` frames `git worktree list --porcelain` at `:527` with `result.stdout.splitlines()`. Measured with a worktree at `…/odd` + U+0085 + `dir`:

```
real records (non-empty LF lines): 6
records via splitlines(): 9
parsed path: 'worktree /private/tmp/…/odd'      ← `dir` became a phantom record
```

`Path(...).resolve()` does not raise for a missing path, so nothing marks the truncation. The single caller (`:660`) then uses that value for `_clean_worktree(checked_out_path)` and, if it passes, `_git(checked_out_path, "reset", "--hard", candidate_sha)`:

- truncated path does not exist → `git -C` fails and the operator sees a worktree error (`_git` raises with git's own message), never "your path was mis-framed";
- truncated path exists as another checkout → cleanliness is judged there and `reset --hard` is executed **in the wrong working tree**.

## Desired outcome / 期望行为

Frame machine records by the separator the writer actually emits — LF — as #5058 did for the startup stderr channel, and keep the `continue`-on-malformed guard for genuinely malformed data instead of letting it absorb framing damage. Do not widen which characters are legal in a name or a path, and do not change what the recommendation logic excludes or what the integration sync writes.

## Scope / 范围

Verified as machine-format streams (reproduced above): `integration_branch/core.py:527` and `issue_fix/reviewer_recommendation.py:650`.

Same grep shape, **not** triaged — someone must read each before claiming it: `issue_fix/acceptance_loop.py:156,243,246`; `change_quality/scope.py:58`; `doctor_git.py:177` (`git remote get-url`); `canary/maintainability_ratchet.py:216` (`git ls-files *.py`); `canary/runner.py:181` and `cli_commands/canary.py:82`; `codex_cli_runtime_probe.py:234`; `dashboard_launcher.py:117`; `benchmark_toolkit/container_binding.py:95`.

Explicitly excluded after checking: `reviewer_recommendation.py:628` parses `git diff --name-only`, which cannot carry a raw U+0085 because `core.quotePath` octal-escapes non-ASCII pathnames by default. Any fix should state which streams are quoted and which are not, so the next reader does not re-report the safe one.

## Acceptance / 验收

- A commit whose author name contains U+0085 (and one containing U+2028) yields exactly one history row whose name is the full author name, and the `DROPPED` branch of the loop is not what consumes it.
- A worktree whose path contains U+0085 resolves to the full path, and a torn prefix is never returned; the record count parsed equals the count of LF-terminated records.
- Both regressions are shown to fail when framing is reverted to `splitlines()`, and the existing exclusion / integration-sync behaviours are unchanged for ordinary ASCII names and paths.
- The excluded-but-adjacent `git diff --name-only` site is documented as safe rather than "fixed", with the quoting rule as the reason.

Related: #5057 / #5058 (same root cause, different channel). Not a duplicate of #4308 or #3558, which are about repository worktree selection and delivery verification, not record framing.

items.title: [duplicate of #10851] tooling(lsp4ij): compute the deterministic next-ready writer frontier

labels.name: spec-reviewed
labels.description: Spec planner has completed implementation spec; ready for red TDD builder

items.body:
Parent/controller: #10550
Train predecessors: C01 manifest + C02 validator + C03 current-tree state
Programme: #8539 / #7873

## Train position

**C04 — deterministic work frontier.** Consumes the current-tree implementation states; it does not inspect live GitHub state or assign work.

## One-PR outcome

Implement:

```bash
cargo xtask integration lsp4ij train next
```

The command returns the exact hard-dependency-ready implementation frontier, grouped by writer slot and conflict key, with complete blocking explanations for every non-ready node.

It is a planning surface. It is not a scheduler, agent launcher, branch creator, PR creator, lease service, merge queue, or behavior verdict.

## Frontier rules

A node is `ready` only when:

```text
role is an implementation leaf
+ node is not landed/superseded/transferred/not-applicable
+ every hard dependency is landed_current_tree or explicitly satisfied
+ required external gate is satisfied where the node is allowed to start
+ no current repository-declared writer occupies its conflict key
+ node contract and implementation-state evidence are valid/current
```

Evidence dependencies may permit fixture/schema preparation without allowing a product/evidence claim. Represent this explicitly; do not silently treat evidence-prep readiness as full implementation readiness.

## Output

For each ready node emit at least:

```text
stable node_id and issue
one-PR outcome
writer slot and conflict key
hard/evidence/external dependencies
maximum evidence stage and claim ceiling
current-tree subject/digest
reason ready
recommended predecessor/current-main base
```

For each blocked node emit the first exact blocking terms, preserving all independent blockers in machine output.

Provide deterministic human and JSON output. Ordering is by graph topology, programme lane, writer slot, conflict key, then stable node ID—not by issue number, label, age, or title.

## Writer discipline

Preserve the campaign rule of at most three active implementation writers:

```text
A — protocol/schema/xtask/generated authorities
B — exact-host LSP journeys
C — managed install and DAP
```

The command may report multiple ready nodes in one slot when conflict keys are disjoint. It does not choose an assignee or claim that a live writer is absent; the explicit live observer later joins that fact.

## Required views

Support at least:

```text
all ready nodes
one writer slot
one programme lane
one issue/node explanation
blocked-only summary
external-gate summary
```

A node with an unresolved canonical-owner/supersession question is blocked, not ready.

## Falsifiers

The suite fails when:

1. a controller appears in the frontier;
2. a hard dependency is missing but the child appears ready;
3. an evidence dependency is treated as a hard implementation pass or vice versa;
4. an externally gated released-built-in node appears before an exact release;
5. two overlapping conflict keys appear concurrently;
6. a landed/superseded/transferred node re-enters the frontier;
7. issue labels, age, or live PR state alter offline readiness;
8. one evidence stage makes a later-stage child ready by inference;
9. a blocked denominator/platform row disappears;
10. repeated output order or digest changes without semantic movement.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `train next` returns the exact offline hard-dependency-ready frontier.
- [ ] Controllers and completed/superseded/transferred nodes cannot appear.
- [ ] Hard, evidence, and external gates remain separate.
- [ ] Writer slots and conflict keys are load-bearing.
- [ ] Ready and blocked explanations are exact and actionable.
- [ ] Human/JSON output is deterministic and filterable.
- [ ] No GitHub query, assignment, agent launch, branch/PR creation, merge action, host execution, or claim promotion exists.

## Verification

```bash
cargo test -p xtask --locked lsp4ij_train_next
cargo xtask integration lsp4ij train check
cargo xtask integration lsp4ij train next --format json
cargo fmt --all -- --check
git diff --check
```

## Codex goal prompt

Implement the offline deterministic `train next` frontier over the merged manifest, validator, and current-tree status. Return only implementation leaves whose hard dependencies and repository-declared writer/conflict conditions are satisfied, while preserving evidence and external gates separately. Emit complete ready/blocked reasons and deterministic human/JSON views. Do not inspect GitHub, assign or launch agents, create branches/PRs, or turn readiness into proof or support.

## Non-goals

No live candidate mapping, scheduler, lease/claim service, worktree manager, review/CI admission, host execution, or issue mutation.

items.title: [duplicate of #13] displayの5秒sweepによるCLI周期停止の調査
items.body:
## 概要・確認レベル

利用者から、実機で「CLIの待機時計などが約4秒動く→約2秒止まる、を繰り返す」「ディスプレイ機能も重くなった」と報告されています。

現在のコードには、**display稼働中、5秒ごとに全domainの状態を同期的に複製・再構築・JSON比較する経路**があります。状態に変更がない場合にも実行され、全国の気象警報の履歴を保持した状態では処理量が大きくなります。CLIの周期停止について、優先して実機計測すべき原因候補です。

- 調査基準: `main` の `a58a2f935b694cdbf26d0b054d3adfde9e9d040f`（2026-09-06）。
- **確認済み:** 以下の本番呼び出し経路と、no-op判定に先行する重複した同期処理。
- **未確認:** 実機稼働中の正確なSHA、当該処理の実測時間、CPU profile、報告された2秒停止との時刻一致、導入コミット。
- 本調査では実機・FlEqのテストを実行していません。報告の約6秒周期とコードの5秒タイマーは厳密には一致していないため、周期だけで原因確定とはしません。

## 本番の呼び出し経路

1. [`SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS = 5_000`](https://github.com/Lateo2580/FlEq/blob/a58a2f935b694cdbf26d0b054d3adfde9e9d040f/src/engine/display/constants.ts#L13-L25)。
2. [`InfoDisplayHub.startTimers()`](https://github.com/Lateo2580/FlEq/blob/a58a2f935b694cdbf26d0b054d3adfde9e9d040f/src/engine/display/hub.ts#L460-L491) のinterval callbackが `deps.standbySweep(nowMs)` を同期実行する。
3. [`monitor.ts` のseed配線](https://github.com/Lateo2580/FlEq/blob/a58a2f935b694cdbf26d0b054d3adfde9e9d040f/src/engine/monitor/monitor.ts#L1012-L1042) は `standbySweep: sweepStandbyFoundation`。runtimeがこれをhubへ渡す。
4. [`sweepStandbyFoundation()`](https://github.com/Lateo2580/FlEq/blob/a58a2f935b694cdbf26d0b054d3adfde9e9d040f/src/engine/monitor/monitor.ts#L750-L790) が `persistenceAdmission.sweepAll(nowMs)` を呼ぶ。display非稼働時のmonitor側intervalは60秒で、display稼働時はこの5秒経路へ移る。

SSEクライアント0件時に止まるのは気象promotionの保持時計であり、`standbySweep` 自体には同じ停止条件がありません。**ブラウザを閉じるだけではこの処理は止まりません。**

## 無変更でも発生する処理

[`StandbyPersistenceAdmissionCoordinator.sweepAll()`](https://github.com/Lateo2580/FlEq/blob/a58a2f935b694cdbf26d0b054d3adfde9e9d040f/src/engine/display/standby-persistence-admission.ts#L686-L870) は、期限切れの有無を確定する前に次を実行します。

- `capture()` で7 ownerのsnapshotを取得し、さらに `structuredClone(captured.domains)` で全体のdraftを作る。
- 各holderを `fromSnapshot()` で再構築し、retain/sweep後に再びsnapshotを取得する。全国気象警報のcurrentだけでなくhistory・partialStreams・partialHistoryも対象になる。
- [`changedOwnerKeys()`](https://github.com/Lateo2580/FlEq/blob/a58a2f935b694cdbf26d0b054d3adfde9e9d040f/src/engine/display/standby-persistence-admission.ts#L440-L514) で、全ownerのbefore/afterを `canonicalJson()` で比較する。

さらに [`Vpws50StateHolder`](https://github.com/Lateo2580/FlEq/blob/a58a2f935b694cdbf26d0b054d3adfde9e9d040f/src/engine/messages/vpws50-state.ts#L653-L682) は次の実装です。

```ts
private refreshOwnerVersion(): void {
  const next = JSON.stringify(this.exportPersistedState());
  if (this.ownerFingerprint != null && this.ownerFingerprint !== next) this.ownerVersion += 1;
  this.ownerFingerprint = next;
}

version(): number { this.refreshOwnerVersion(); return this.ownerVersion; }

cloneSnapshot(): Vpws50StateSnapshot {
  this.refreshOwnerVersion();
  return { version: this.ownerVersion, state: structuredClone(this.exportPersistedState()) };
}
```

単なるversion取得もO(保存状態サイズ)の再export＋JSON化です。`capture()` のsnapshot取得とtoken取得、draft holderの復元、再snapshotで同じ状態を繰り返し処理します。加えて [`retainActiveSubjects()`](https://github.com/Lateo2580/FlEq/blob/a58a2f935b694cdbf26d0b054d3adfde9e9d040f/src/engine/messages/vpws50-state.ts#L910-L936) も、削除がない場合を含めて保存状態のbefore/afterをJSON化します。

`constants.ts` には、2026-09-02のPiで旧版v2保存ファイル **5,202,939 bytes** を観測した記録があります。これは今回測定した値ではなく、現在の実機メモリ上の状態サイズそのものでもありませんが、数MB級の状態が実運用上存在する根拠です。

**注意:** `sweepAll()` には `changed.length === 0` の早期returnがあり、その場合は後続のv1/v2 pair serialization・保存へ進みません。本件は「5秒ごとに必ずファイルを書いている」という指摘ではなく、**no-opと判定するまでのCPU処理・メモリ割当てが重複している**という指摘です。

## 想定される影響

これらはCLIと同じNode.jsイベントループ上の同期処理です。重い状態の処理中は、時計更新、REPL入力、電文のJavaScript処理、SSE配信のcallbackが遅れ得ます。ファイル書込みだけを非同期化しても、このCPU処理は解消しません。

ただしNode側の停止は、別プロセスで動くChromiumのローカル時計やCSSアニメーションの停止を直接証明するものではありません。displayの「データ更新が遅い」と「画面自体の描画が重い」は分けて計測してください。

参考: [Node.js公式: Don't Block the Event Loop](https://nodejs.org/learn/asynchronous-work/dont-block-the-event-loop)

## 実機での切り分け

1. 実行中のSHA・Node版・起動コマンドを記録し、現在のruntimeデータをローカルに保全する。データ削除による回避はしない。APIキーや生の運用データを公開Issueへ貼らない。
2. 同じ保持状態で `sweepAll()` の開始/終了時刻・所要時間・`changedKeys` を計測し、`monitorEventLoopDelay()` とCPU profileを採取する。計測ログ自体をTTYへ大量出力しない。
3. 安全な検証環境で、display on / ブラウザだけ閉じる / display off を比較する。offでも60秒sweepは残るため、短い観測だけで完全解消と判断しない。
4. no-op sweepを複数回観測し、CLI時計の実際の更新間隔・SSE配信遅延と突き合わせる。5秒sweepに一致しなければ、この候補を確定扱いせず他の処理へ調査を進める。

## 修正方針

- 最優先は、versionを変更時に進める方式等により、`version()` を全状態JSON化から切り離すこと。全mutation経路を覆い、変更検出の取りこぼしを防ぐ。
- 次の期限・変更したowner等から、変更のない大きな状態の複製／復元／比較を省略する。immutable snapshotの再利用や対象owner限定のdraft生成を検討する。
- 重い全domain sweepをdisplayの5秒refreshへ無条件に結び付けない。ただし全体の `SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS` を単純に60秒へ変更すると他の期限処理にも影響するため避ける。
- 実際に変更するtransactionのpreflight、owner間の整合性、取消・期限切れ、v1/v2保存の安全性は維持する。単に検証を削除して高速化しない。

## 完了条件・回帰テスト

- [ ] 大きなVPWS50 current/history/partialを持つno-op sweepのベンチマークを追加し、実機のイベントループ遅延とともに改善前後を記録する。
- [ ] 無変更状態でのversion読取り・期限確認が、全履歴JSON化／全owner複製を反復しないことを検査する。pair serializerが呼ばれないだけのテストでは、現行の問題を検知できない。
- [ ] display on時の時計・REPL・SSE応答性を実機確認する。
- [ ] 期限切れ・取消・owner整合性・保存／復元の既存テストを維持し、今回の実機症状との因果が確認できたかを結果に明記する。

labels.name: spec-reviewed

items.body:
Controller: #7873
Train: #8539 (T2.4)
Depends on: #8674, #8724
Feeds: every actual-host replay, #8107, #8005
Related proof-surface repairs: #10159, #10160

## Objective

Operate the pinned IntelliJ/LSP4IJ harness as a deliberately scoped, receipt-producing CI lane without turning every ordinary PR into a costly or flaky full-IDE matrix.

## Authority boundary

The workflow schedules exact journeys and retains evidence. It does not define feature semantics, support claims, host identities, or a second receipt schema.

## Builder packet

- **Writer slot:** A
- **Conflict key:** `lsp4ij-host-ci`
- **PR title:** `ci: add scoped LSP4IJ actual-host receipts (#<issue>)`
- **Expected size:** M
- **Claim ceiling:** repeatable execution and artifact retention

## Routing model

Run the smallest Linux baseline when:

```text
host driver / LSP4IJ integration material changes
LSP4IJ receipt/schema/registry adapters change
a maintainer applies the explicit validation label
nightly or release-candidate schedule requests currentness
```

Do not run the full host lane for unrelated docs/meta-only or unaffected provider changes. Specialized feature/platform/DAP rows remain separately selected.

## Required implementation

1. Pin the exact runner image/runtime dependencies needed by #8644/#8674.
2. Use isolated config/system/plugin/cache/workspace roots for each run.
3. Build or bind the exact candidate under test; never resolve an ambient PATH binary.
4. Run a named selector, not an open-ended all-feature harness.
5. Enforce wall-clock, startup, action, and cleanup timeouts with distinct failure classes.
6. Retain bounded receipt, subject manifest, host log, server stderr, transcript summary, action trace, and cleanup report.
7. Redact private paths/content and reject oversized/unbounded artifacts.
8. Preserve completed runs; use concurrency that queues the latest request without cancelling useful in-progress evidence.
9. Report product, host-client, instrument, environment, fixture, and cleanup failures separately.
10. Publish a stable summary/check name consumable by #8005 without converting skipped/unavailable rows to pass.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A known-good exact-host baseline produces a schema-valid receipt and bounded artifacts.
- [ ] A deliberately broken candidate, wrong binary, missing plugin, stale fixture, timeout, and orphaned process produce distinct failures.
- [ ] Unrelated changes are routed away from the expensive lane.
- [ ] Re-running the same exact subject yields comparable identity and cell results.
- [ ] A skipped, unavailable, cancelled, or instrument-failed run cannot become support evidence.
- [ ] Artifact retention and redaction satisfy repository policy.
- [ ] CI does not duplicate #8674's driver or #7777's receipt authority.
- [ ] Measured runtime/flake data is retained before any broader required-matrix ratchet.

## Negative controls

Fail when green setup markers replace actual execution, an ambient IDE/plugin/binary passes, broad path globs overrun routing, workflow cancellation destroys the only active receipt, logs leak private content, artifacts are unbounded, or a skipped row disappears from the denominator.

## Proof

Exercise one green baseline and targeted fault cases. Run workflow/static checks, route-selection tests, receipt validation, artifact-policy checks, and a second comparable exact-subject run.

## Rollback

Disable/remove only the scoped workflow and routing metadata. The local host driver and feature journeys remain usable.

## Stop conditions

Stop when the host cannot run reproducibly on the selected runner or requires unbounded downloads/private credentials. Record the environment row as unavailable and keep local/manual exact-host execution; do not weaken the receipt contract.

items.body:
Parent/controller: #8162
Train: #8539 (T8.1)
Depends on: #8674, #8791
Feeds: #7875 desired mappings, #8001, #8005, #7726, #8186

## Objective

Evaluate ordinary extension-based Perl deployment and executable families beyond `.pl`, `.pm`, and `.t` as independent actual-host activation cells, then expand desired mappings only for rows that earn semantic proof.

## Candidate denominator

```text
.PL
.psgi
.cgi
.fcgi
```

Every row remains independent. Add another extension only by amending this issue before implementation with an ambiguity analysis and negative control.

## Builder packet

- **Writer slot:** B
- **Conflict key:** `lsp4ij-file-activation-extension`
- **PR title:** `test: prove LSP4IJ additional extension activation (#<issue>)`
- **Expected size:** M
- **Claim ceiling:** named actual-host file-family rows

## Required proof per row

1. Record native IntelliJ file type before LSP4IJ mapping.
2. Record exact desired/released/user mapping stage.
3. Open through the isolated host and prove the winning exact `perllsp` process.
4. Produce one fixture-defined diagnostic, completion, hover, definition, or symbol discriminator.
5. Exercise a same-extension or nearby non-Perl ambiguity control where relevant.
6. Close and prove document/process cleanup.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Each extension has its own pass/limited/unsupported/not-proven result.
- [ ] Parser support, highlighting, filename shape, or template presence cannot pass a row.
- [ ] Broad patterns cannot capture an unrelated control.
- [ ] Desired mappings change only for exact passing local-imported rows.
- [ ] Local/user mapping cannot become released-built-in support.
- [ ] One extension cannot satisfy another.
- [ ] Registry/docs update from exact rows only.

## Negative controls

Fail when a row inherits `.pl`, one mapping proves another, a non-Perl control activates `perllsp`, another provider supplies semantics, or an unreceipted extension enters desired state.

## Rollback

Revert activation journeys, receipts, and any resulting desired mapping expansion. Baseline `.pl/.pm/.t` remains unchanged.

## Stop conditions

Record the exact native file-type or mapping limitation instead of adding a JetBrains plugin or broad wildcard. POD, XS, templates, generated and embedded Perl remain out of scope.

Parent/controller: #8004
Train: #8539 (T7.3)
Depends on: #8002 status/check child, #8565
Feeds: deterministic local-delta child, #7945

## Objective

Implement the explicit network-assisted refresh which imports only the bounded Perl LSP/DAP integration surfaces from one exact reviewed LSP4IJ subject and leaves a reviewable local evidence change.

## Builder packet

- **Writer slot:** A
- **Conflict key:** `lsp4ij-upstream-refresh`
- **PR title:** `feat: add exact-ref LSP4IJ refresh (#<issue>)`
- **Expected size:** M
- **Claim ceiling:** reviewed upstream evidence import

## Contract

Equivalent interface:

```bash
cargo xtask integration lsp4ij refresh --upstream-ref <exact-ref>
```

Require a release/tag/commit or explicitly reviewed named ref and record the resolved commit. Import only the manifest-approved Perl LSP, Perl DAP, settings, installer, file-mapping, and documentation paths. Preserve source paths, raw digests, normalization version, and semantic drift classification.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Floating `main`, `HEAD`, or unresolved branch authority is rejected.
- [ ] The exact resolved commit and every bounded source identity are retained.
- [ ] Unrelated upstream content cannot enter the fixture.
- [ ] Released evidence remains separate from repository desired state.
- [ ] Upstream drift and local canonical-input drift are reported independently.
- [ ] Fixture replacement remains an explicit reviewed repository diff.
- [ ] Re-import of the same exact subject is deterministic and second-run clean.
- [ ] Refresh cannot promote compatibility, support, submission, merge, or release state.
- [ ] No external write occurs.

## Negative controls

Fail when moving upstream is silently accepted, desired files overwrite released evidence, unrelated paths enter, normalization drops behavior-bearing fields, same-subject output drifts, ordinary offline check invokes refresh, or any branch/PR/issue mutation is attempted.

## Proof

Run exact-ref, bounded-path, digest, normalization, no-external-write, and second-run tests plus the authoritative verification chain.

## Rollback

Revert refresh implementation and refreshed fixture together where appropriate; prior reviewed basis remains authoritative.

## Stop conditions

Stop when upstream restructuring cannot be mapped without broad import or semantic guessing. Record the first unmapped surface for maintainer review rather than auto-accepting it.

Feeds: project-reopen/repeated-session child, #8001, #8005, #8107, #8186

## Objective

Prove one generation-owned language-server cutover for explicit restart and unexpected `perllsp` exit. The exact host must replace the old process, replay current documents once, restore current semantics, and reject every late old-generation result.

## Authority boundary

This issue owns server-process generation cutover inside an already running exact IntelliJ/LSP4IJ host. It does not own full IDE restart, project reopen, long-session resource trends, installation repair, or provider semantics.

## Builder packet

- **Writer slot:** B
- **Conflict key:** `lsp4ij-recovery-cutover`
- **PR title:** `test: prove LSP4IJ server generation cutover (#<issue>)`
- **Expected size:** M
- **Claim ceiling:** explicit-restart and crash-recovery cells

## Required rows

```text
explicit language-server restart
unexpected process exit after initialized
exit while a request is held
exit after an edit before diagnostics settle
bounded startup failure followed by successful retry
final clean shutdown
```

For each row retain prior/new PID, candidate digest, server generation, document versions, root/configuration/template identities, pending operations, retry/backoff disposition, current diagnostic set, one navigation or completion discriminator, and cleanup.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Old and new process/generation identities are unambiguous.
- [ ] The old process cannot answer, register, publish diagnostics/progress, or apply edits after cutover.
- [ ] Open documents replay exactly once at their current host versions.
- [ ] Current diagnostics and one semantic discriminator recover against the intended root/configuration.
- [ ] Retry count, backoff, exhaustion, and user-visible failure are bounded.
- [ ] Recovery cannot switch to PATH, stale cache, another template, or another Perl provider.
- [ ] No duplicate server, request, registration, watcher, progress stream, or recovery task survives.
- [ ] Clean first-launch evidence cannot satisfy a recovery row.

## Negative controls

Fail when an old response wins, documents replay twice or at stale versions, retries loop without bound, another binary/provider satisfies readiness, stale diagnostics remain, process identity is unknown, or forced cleanup is reported as graceful success.

## Proof

Use deterministic held requests and process controls rather than timing races. Run the focused actual-host recovery selector, receipt validation, and authoritative verification chain. Retain bounded process and operation histories.

## Rollback

Revert the recovery journeys/receipts. The base host and clean lifecycle remain valid but no recovery claim survives.

## Stop conditions

Transfer a generic lifecycle defect to its owning server issue when the host exposes one. Stop as `not_proven` when LSP4IJ provides no deterministic restart/crash observation; do not replace the actual host with a synthetic process test.

items.title: [Duplicate of #18] [GTO-02] tournament/cash/drill 게임 모드와 fixed-blind 6-max 훈련 환경을 추가한다
items.body:
## 배경

현재 `engine/hand.js`의 기본 게임은 5000 stack, 25/50 blind, `levelEvery=8`인 상승 블라인드 토너먼트형입니다. 실제 게임에는 적합하지만 stack depth·blind level·seat count가 계속 변해 정적인 preflop training tree와 비교하기 어렵습니다.

선행 이슈: GTO-01

설계 문서: [`GTO_LEARNING_SYSTEM_ROADMAP.md`](https://github.com/Sungmin-Cho/AI-Holdem/blob/docs/gto-learning-system-roadmap-20260831/docs/design/GTO_LEARNING_SYSTEM_ROADMAP.md)

## 목표

기존 tournament 동작을 보존하면서 학습 목적에 맞는 고정 환경을 선택할 수 있게 합니다.

```text
mode = tournament | cash | drill
```

## 설계

### tournament

- 현재 동작과 기본값을 그대로 유지
- blind level 상승과 bust/gameOver 규칙 회귀 금지

### cash

- blinds/ante 고정
- level-up event 없음
- stack은 세션 동안 지속
- strategy evaluator가 실제 effective stack을 bucket에 매칭하거나 unsupported 처리

### drill

- seeded scenario 또는 한 hand 단위 실행
- 문제 종료 후 지정 stack/button/seat/action prefix로 재설정 가능
- 결과보다 결정 반복을 우선

### CLI/설정

- `createGame` config에 mode와 ante/fixed blind 의미 추가
- `tools/game-loop.js`와 `/start-game`에 명시적 option 추가
- schemaVersion/migration 또는 이전 state 호환 방침 명시
- Phase 1 표준 preset: user + AI 5명, 100BB, no ante, fixed blinds

## 대상 파일

- `engine/hand.js`
- `engine/cli.js`
- `tools/game-loop.js`
- `.agents/skills/start-game/SKILL.md`
- `README.md`
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `test/hand.test.js` 및 game-loop integration tests

## 완료 조건

- [ ] option 미지정 시 기존 tournament 동작과 동일함
- [ ] cash mode에서 수백 hand를 진행해도 blind가 상승하지 않음
- [ ] cash mode에서 `level_up` event가 발생하지 않음
- [ ] drill mode의 동일 seed가 동일 seat/button/cards/action prefix를 재현함
- [ ] 6-max preset이 canonical `UTG/HJ/CO/BTN/SB/BB`를 사용함
- [ ] mode/config가 archive·resume 후 보존됨
- [ ] 이전 state schema에 대한 명시적 호환 또는 fail-closed migration이 있음
- [ ] CLI 사용법과 문서 계약 테스트가 동기화됨
- [ ] 기존 side-pot/all-in/showdown 테스트가 모두 통과함

## 비범위

- strategy lookup 및 EV grading
- MTT ICM
- rake 모델의 정교한 구현; 초기에는 capability/config로 명시

items.title: [Duplicate of S3-08] Make the worker survive transient database and polling-loop failures
items.body:
**Problem**
`app.worker::run_forever()` calls `run_once()` without a runtime error boundary. Adapter exceptions are handled inside `process_job()`, but database disconnects, transaction failures, migration/schema errors, session invalidation, or failures in stale recovery and batch claiming can escape and terminate the entire worker process. An external restart policy can then create a crash loop, while one poison job or transient outage prevents unrelated due work from progressing.

**Fix**
Add a bounded worker-supervision loop with rollback/session disposal, classified retry behavior, exponential backoff and jitter, graceful shutdown, and observable liveness/readiness state. Isolate recoverable per-job failures from process-level failures without acknowledging work that was not safely committed, and coordinate ownership guarantees with the worker-lease issue.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] A simulated transient database outage causes bounded backoff and successful reconnection without a hot crash loop or duplicate provider action
- [ ] One malformed/poison job cannot terminate the worker or indefinitely block unrelated due jobs, and its disposition is explicit and observable
- [ ] Worker health exposes last successful poll, consecutive failures, and readiness, with tests for rollback, reconnect, shutdown, and process-level fatal configuration errors

items.title: [duplicate of #10553] tooling(lsp4ij): reconcile live PR candidates against the canonical train

labels.name: spec-reviewed
labels.description: Spec planner has completed implementation spec; ready for red TDD builder

items.body:
Parent/controller: #10550
Train predecessors: C01 canonical manifest + C02 validator + C03 current-tree state + C04 frontier
Programme: #8539 / #7873
Generic review/CI authorities: #3390 / #3693 / #6275

## Train position

**C06 — explicit read-only live candidate observer.** This is the only C-series leaf allowed to query GitHub. It joins collaboration state onto the stable offline train but cannot mutate issues, branches, pull requests, labels, reviews, checks, or releases.

## One-PR outcome

Add an explicit network-assisted command equivalent to:

```bash
cargo xtask integration lsp4ij train observe --repo EffortlessMetrics/perl-lsp-swarm
```

The command maps open/recent PRs and issue state to canonical train nodes, identifies duplicate or stale candidates, and produces a deterministic bounded reconciliation packet for a human or orchestrating agent.

Ordinary `train check`, `status`, `next`, `explain`, and `graph` remain offline.

## Authority boundary

The observer answers:

```text
which live candidate appears to claim this node?
what exact base/head and current collaboration state does it have?
is it canonical, stacked, distinct, stale, duplicate, salvage-only, or ambiguous?
```

It does not answer whether the implementation is landed/current, a behavior receipt passes, a support claim is earned, or a PR should merge.

## Inputs

Bind exact:

```text
repository identity
observation timestamp and API/schema version
canonical train manifest/digest
current default-branch SHA
PR number/base/head/head-repository/draft state
linked issues and explicit train/node IDs
changed-file summary and patch/tree identity where available
review decision and review-head identity
check-run/check-suite subjects and conclusions
mergeability/merge-queue state as reported, not inferred
comments/labels only where typed by the train contract
```

A title or issue-number mention alone is candidate evidence, not proof of ownership.

## Candidate classification

Use explicit states equivalent to:

```text
no_candidate
canonical_candidate
explicit_stack
parallel_distinct_slice
stale_candidate
wrong_base_or_history
wrong_controller
wrong_evidence_stage
duplicate_candidate
superseded_candidate
salvage_source
ambiguous_owner
head_moved_after_proof
checks_pending_or_incomplete
review_missing_or_stale
ready_for_generic_integration_evaluation
```

The final state delegates merge/integration judgment to #3390/#3693/#6275. Do not create a second repository merge policy.

## Semantic matching

Candidate mapping considers, in order:

1. explicit stable node ID / issue contract;
2. exact controlling issue and one-PR result;
3. claimed evidence stage and subject;
4. writer/conflict surface;
5. changed-file and patch semantics;
6. stack/base relationship;
7. preserved unique work and current-tree overlap.

Do not classify duplicates from title similarity alone. When uncertain, return `ambiguous_owner` with the conflicting terms.

## Reconciliation packet

For every node/candidate pair emit:

```text
node and one-PR result
current offline readiness
candidate PR/base/head and observed time
candidate classification
exact overlap or divergence evidence
proof/check/review subject currentness
recommended next action = continue | rebase/reconstruct | review |
                          salvage | transfer | supersede | close |
                          wait for dependency | investigate ambiguity
forbidden automatic action
```

Recommendations are advisory. The command performs no action.

## Cheap-agent use

The observer should make the safe action obvious:

- continue one canonical current candidate;
- salvage unique commits/fixtures from stale history into a new current-main candidate;
- close/supersede a true duplicate only after preserved-work review;
- do not open another candidate while ownership is ambiguous;
- do not treat green checks on an older head as current;
- do not repair a wrong-stage candidate by weakening the node contract.

## Bounds and privacy

- bound PRs, commits, files, comments, checks, reviews, and text retained per observation;
- retain IDs/digests and concise evidence, not unbounded logs;
- redact tokens and private/local paths;
- cache only explicit observation artifacts under repository policy;
- API unavailable/rate-limited/partial becomes `instrument_failed`/`not_proven`, never `no_candidate` or green.

## Falsifiers

Fail or downgrade when:

1. title similarity alone declares a duplicate;
2. an issue mention overrides a conflicting one-PR result;
3. an older reviewed/green head satisfies a moved head;
4. a draft or pending/incomplete check set is rendered merge-ready;
5. one evidence stage is mistaken for another;
6. a stale branch is treated as current-tree implementation;
7. ambiguous ownership is auto-resolved;
8. API failure becomes no candidate/pass;
9. the command edits a label, issue, branch, PR, review, check, or release;
10. live state leaks into offline deterministic train outputs.

## Acceptance

- [ ] One explicit command maps live candidates to canonical train nodes.
- [ ] Mapping is semantic, subject-bound, and uncertainty-preserving.
- [ ] Exact base/head, proof/check/review currentness, and stack relations are visible.
- [ ] Canonical, distinct, stale, duplicate, salvage, wrong-stage, and ambiguous states remain separate.
- [ ] API partial/failure is non-green.
- [ ] Generic merge/review policy remains #3390/#3693/#6275.
- [ ] No GitHub or external mutation is reachable.
- [ ] Offline train commands remain network-free and deterministic.

## Verification

```bash
cargo test -p xtask --locked lsp4ij_train_observe
cargo xtask integration lsp4ij train check
# recorded API fixtures for canonical/stacked/stale/duplicate/ambiguous/head-moved cases
cargo fmt --all -- --check
git diff --check
```

Live API smoke is optional/advisory and records exact observation identity. Unit/contract tests use bounded fixtures.

## Codex goal prompt

Add one explicit read-only `train observe` command that joins live GitHub PR/review/check/base/head state to canonical LSP4IJ train nodes. Classify canonical, stacked, distinct, stale, duplicate, salvage, wrong-stage, head-moved, and ambiguous candidates from exact contracts and patch subjects—not titles alone. Emit bounded advisory reconciliation packets and preserve API failure as instrument failure. Do not mutate GitHub or create another merge/review policy.

## Non-goals

No assignment, scheduler, lease, branch/worktree creation, commit, push, PR/issue/comment/label/review/check mutation, merge, release, support promotion, or replacement of #3390/#3693/#6275.
